mechanism: Atovaquone may inhibit the metabolism of nortriptyline via CYP3A4 and CYP2D6 pathways, potentially increasing nortriptyline plasma concentrations and anticholinergic/cardiotoxic effects.
action: Monitor for increased nortriptyline adverse effects (anticholinergic symptoms, cardiac arrhythmias, QT prolongation); consider nortriptyline dose reduction or therapeutic drug monitoring if concurrent use is necessary.
